Hard water in Ballarat leads to mineral buildup inside pipes, narrowing the flow over time. Installing a water softener or regularly flushing drains with hot water can mitigate this. Outdoor drains in Ballarat are vulnerable to leaves, dirt, and stormwater debris, especially during autumn. Keeping gutters clean and installing drain covers prevents external blockages.
